prompts.prompt: A mountain of crispy tortilla chips loaded with melted, gooey yellow cheddar cheese, bright green jalapeño slices, thick dollops of white sour cream, and fresh pico de gallo. Dark background, cinematic food lighting.

Plump shrimp sizzling in a heavy cast-iron pan. Bathed in foaming, golden garlic butter sauce, flecked with chopped green parsley. Charred lemon wedges on the side, thick steam rising, hyper-detailed.
